types.nonce: canonical base64url of 32 bytes without padding
types.inbox_state_ref: sha256 of LAB/08.2/STATE NUL plus canonical immutable transaction record
types.other_fields: same exact bounded handles, pins and semantics as Foundation 08.1

constraints: exact field sets; reject unknown or missing fields
node and key are pinned out of band, never trusted from packet
signing only after immutable state record fsync and retained CAS commit
receipt is historical node evidence, never a Human mandate
duplicate exact receipt is historical replay, not a new effect
late ACK never lowers a retained authority frontier
